spans.s: f. an arrow, RV.; AV.; VS.; MBh.; Ragh.; Śak. &c.
(in mathematics) a versed sine
N. of a Soma ceremony, KātyŚr.
the number five, Sāh.
N. of a particular constellation, VarBṛ. xii, 7.

etym.s: [According to Dayānanda इषु may mean ‘ray of light’; cf. Gk. ἰός; Zd. ishu.]

spans.s: du. (also) N. of two Viṣṭutis, ŚrS.
इषु-धि, &c. See 1. इष्.
इषु—कामशमी f. N. of a region Comm. on Pāṇ. ii, 1, 50.
इषु—कार॑ or -कृ॑त् (1. इषु-कृत्, for 2. see s.v.), m. an arrow-maker, RV.; AV.; MBh.; Kap. &c.
इषु—कार॑ or -कृ॑त् (1. इषु-कृत्, for 2. see s.v.), m. an arrow-maker, RV.; AV.; MBh.; Kap. &c.
2. इषु-कृ॑त् mfn. (only RV. i, 184, 3) = इष्-कृत्, preparing, arranging [NBD.]
, hurting like an arrow [Gmn.], Sāy. reads इषु-कृ॑त, and explains it by ‘made quick as an arrow’.
इषु—क्षेप m. (the distance of) an arrow shot, Lalit.
इषु—धन्व॑ (TĀr.) or इषु—धन्वन्, n. (sg.) arrow and bow,
इषु—धन्व॑ (TĀr.) or इषु—धन्वन्, n. (sg.) arrow and bow,
इषु—धन्वि॑न् m. an archer, TĀr.
इषु—धर m. an archer.
इषु—धि॑ m. (√ धा), a quiver, RV.; AV.; VS.; R. &c.
इषु—धि॑—मत् mfn. possessed of a quiver, VS.
इषु—निबन्धन a quiver, R.
इषु—प m. N. of an Asura (who appeared on earth as king Nagnajit), MBh.
इषु—पथ m. the range of an arrow, L.
इषु—पद् (strong form -पाद्), m. N. of an Asura (v.l. -प), MBh.
इषु—पर्षिन् mfn. showering arrows, ŚBr.
इषु—पात m. an arrow's flight (as a measure of distance), MBh.
इषु—पुष्पा f. N. of a plant.
इ॑षु—बल (इ॑षु˚), mfn. powerful by arrows, RV. vi, 75, 9.
इषु—भृ॑त् mfn. carrying arrows, an archer, AV.; Bhaṭṭ.
इ॑षु—मत् (इ॑षु˚), mfn. possessed of arrows, RV.; VS.; TS.; AV.; Daś.
इषु—मात्र॑ n. the length of an arrow, Āp. i, 15, 19
इषु—मात्र॑ mfn. having the length of an arrow (about three feet), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
इषु—मात्र॑म् (अ॑म्), ind. as far as the range of an arrow, ŚBr.; TS.; ŚāṅkhBr.
इषु—मार्ग m. ‘arrow-path’, the atmosphere, L.
इषु—मुख n. the point of an arrow, TĀr.
इषु—वध॑ m. death by an arrow, ŚBr. v, 4, 2, 2.
इषु—वर्ष m. a shower of arrows, Daś.
इषु—विक्षेप m. (= -पात above),VP.
इषु—साह्व m. N. of a plant,
Hariv. 3843
इषु—˚स्-त्रिकाण्डा f. ‘the threefold arrow’, N. of a constellation (perhaps the girdle of Orion), AitBr.
इषु—हत mfn. killed by an arrow, TāṇḍyaBr. xxii, 14, 3.
इषु—हस्त mfn. ‘arrow-handed’, carrying arrows in the hand.
इ—˚षू-गुह mfn. hiding arrows, Kauś.
arrow-like g. स्थूलादि, Pāṇ. v, 4, 3
ifc. = इ॑षु (e.g. त्रीषुकं धनुस्, KātyŚr.)
(आ॑), f. an arrow, AV. i, 3, 9

1. इषुध्य Nom. (fr. इषु-धि) P. Ā. इषुध्यति, -ते, to be a quiver, contain arrows g. कण्ड्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 27;
 (for 2. इषुध्य, also for इषुध्या and इषुध्यु See next col.)

2. इषुध्य Nom. P. इषुध्य॑ति, to implore, request, crave for (dat.), RV.;
 [cf. Zd. ishud , ‘prayer’; ishûidyāmahi, ‘we will pray’.]
imploring, request, RV. i, 122, 1.
imploring, requesting, RV. v, 41, 6.
P. इषूयति (dat. of the pres. p. इषूयते॑, RV. i, 128, 4) to strive for, endeavour to obtain.
